item: row 313: no write follows a link in a backup, export or staging folder
key_paths: src/backup/regular_file.py src/safety/crypto.py src/backup/volumes.py src/backup/parity.py src/backup/stream_backup.py src/backup/export_summary.py src/backup/folder_backup.py src/backup/artifact.py
summary: create_new (remove the name as itself, then O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW; folders and Windows reparse points refused) and replace_with (a temporary made that way, then a rename) now carry every write into a backup, export or restore-staging folder: volumes, manifests, the building record, parity and its rebuild, the export summary, the folder-backup manifest, the single-file backup and the restore working copies; a link planted at any of those names is replaced, never written through
